platform: ARM64 macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), SDK 27.0, deployment target macOS 14

explorerSoak.reason: Five main-queue probes exceeded the predeclared one-second maximum latency
explorerSoak.postLoadScrollExplanation: Insertion/interaction exercise already exceeded the predeclared 135-second minimum
explorerSoak.memoryInterpretation: Approximately 792 MiB; includes retained views/archive models and OS/SwiftUI caches. This is not proof of a leak or its absence.
explorerSoak.coverageLimit: Uses the real native Explorer host and local preview pipeline with durable CaptureStore saves plus AppState.didAutoCapture, not live clipboard polling. Synthetic resizing includes 260/300-point widths below the usual production minimum. Independent queue probes are not direct input or compositor FPS measurements; one outstanding probe can underrepresent time spent stalled. Small 320x200 PNG fixtures do not cover large-payload or OCR pressure.

autoCaptureQueueStress.coverage: Actual AutoCaptureService with private named NSPasteboard, isolated preferences/archive, small fictional text/TXT content, observation-time project/content snapshots, durable callbacks, ordering, pause/resume, shutdown/restart and repository reopen. No system screenshot monitoring or real clipboard.
autoCaptureQueueStress.coverageLimit: Separate from the Explorer UI soak; not an end-to-end real-source workload or large-file capacity test.

initialHarnessCompileAttempt.resolution: Added required explicit self to a recursive test-harness closure; no production change or threshold relaxation
